command.description: The unace command to perform: 'e' (extract), 'l' (list), 't' (test), 'v' (verbose list), or 'x' (extract with full path).

archive_path.description: Path to the ACE archive file to process.

destination_dir.description: Target directory for extracted files when using 'e' or 'x' commands.

auto_yes.description: If true, passes the -y switch to assume 'yes' on all questions, never asking for input.
